notes.title: The 2022 Season Update is now live !
notes.notes:
Play now with data for the 2022 season, or if you wish data for 2021, 2020 and even the 2019 season.
Just select your preferred season from the game start up screen.

notes.title: Nations Cup has now been added to RLTM3 DLC.
notes.notes:
Nations Cup has now been added to RLTM3 DLC.

The Nations Cup game includes :  
The opportunity to play as 1 of 16 nations
32-man squad selection
4 pools of matches followed by knock-out finals
All the tactics and team selection from the main RLTM3 game
Full match engine from the main RLTM3 game
The Nations Cup game is accessible from the main menu of the RLTM3 DLC . . .

Please note: You must install RLTM3 DLC in order to play.

notes.title: Season Update 2021
notes.notes:
New Update!

All kits, clubs and badges have been updated for the 2021 Season.

There is an added menu option to the title screen where you can select the 2021 Season Data Set.
Many  thanks to all those fans of the game that helped  in making this.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Faster Processing Update
notes.notes:
We have optimised the processing of fortnightly changes.  It can now be up to 6 times faster than previous builds.

Get this update for an even better experience.
Thanks for your feedback and please continue to enjoy the game!

notes.title: New Update
notes.notes:
We've added the Kit Preview tool to the main menu of the game, for preview only of 3D kit files.  Use this to see how kit textures that you have modified yourself, using your own graphics software, look on the 3D player model. You can also render 2D shirts for the UI from your designs.

We have also added 3 new forwards moves and 3 new backs moves in the match.  These can be selected in an Ad-Lib attack, and are incorporated in the Structured attack.

notes.title: Workshop Database Sharing
notes.notes:
A separate Steam Workshop tool has been added to the in game editor.  This allows you to save and upload workshop database files that you can then upload to the Steam Workshop community area.

We have left the editor slots for game databases as they were.
The workshop area is an addition and you can now share your database files using the Steam Workshop.

Please read the guide for a full explanation by pressing the Learn More button in the Community Workshop area in your Steam client..

notes.title: October 12 Update
notes.notes: Sin bins and sendings off are now fully live in all versions  RLTM3 and RLTM3+ DLC [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36438070/ac084519b3a73c140fbdcea2288bf13d09b3c62b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Thank you for your support![/h2]

Based on your feedback, we are pleased to announce the following additions to the game :-

[h3]Attribute Search Screen[/h3]
We have now added the Attributes Screen to the game.
This allows. you to search for players by an attribute value range, then add to the Player Shortlist to sign them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36438070/fa307bcd82bc95e3f43a48b61a634158038adaae.png[/img]

[h3]The Stats Hub[/h3]
We have added :-  “The Stats Hub“ which is now live in both RLTM3 and RLTM3 DLC.
Which allows you to search players statistics, for a given league.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36438070/f32aa05a78801f3e08749b484656e5412dac297b.png[/img]

[h3]Overall Stat[/h3]
We have added “Overall” to the Player Attributes Popup which is accessible on most screens To access you just hover over the icon. There's one for all players on most screens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36438070/f156553178e5120af48a343a3a5560f12e730a36.png[/img]

notes.title: New Update
notes.notes:
New Camera Angles added for the 3D Match.
New kicking variation added.
Plus further gameplay improvements.

Thanks for all your support!

notes.title: 2020 Data Update Addition
notes.notes:
You now have a choice to play with the All New 2020 data, or play with 2019 data, it is your choice.

This update also, allows :- New Recruits to be added to training groups, plus features other minor issue fixes.

notes.title: March 31st UPDATE
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36438070/a47f2365a703b255db719338515efd4b350ceace.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36438070/a47f2365a703b255db719338515efd4b350ceace.gif[/img][/url]“We’ve been hard at work, making your suggestions a reality! Here’s what is included in this latest game update for RLTM 3: -
The editor now features the much requested add new player function. Gone are the days of moving players from lower squads, you can now add new players as seasons update and keep the game feeling fresh. -
The long awaited Forward/Back buttons in the navigating menus has finally been implemented. You can now navigate the menus with much more efficiency now that this feature has been added. 
Managing your squads has never been easier! -A multitude of minor issue fixes have also been implemented but we won’t bore you with those…  Please enjoy the game.

notes.title: New Update 3rd March
notes.notes:
[b]First Update of March has landed, here’s what’s included:[/b]
-PNG club nationality fixed
-NZ Warriors in Div1 nationality fixed
-Audio loop bug fixed
-Canadian League is no longer just USA players
-Danny Washbrook duplicate fixed, should have been Liam Harris
-Harry Newman and Jack Broadbent primary and secondary positions fixed
-Manager stats should now accumulate
-Oceania cup ¼ drew negative numbers is now fixed
-Loaning/Selling a player no longer stops them from accepting future contract offers, this is also the same for having previous failed negotiations with a player
-Tooltip now says Back instead of Backwards
-Re-training position in Individual Training no longer stays at 0%
-Can now sort by tabs (calibre, value etc.) in Team Selection
-Editor now includes player potential, player appearance (skin, hair, beard) and the removed players panel is now larger for mass-moving of players

notes.title: New Update 10th February
notes.notes:
[b]The Latest Update has landed, fixes include the following! :[/b]
-Potential is now added to the editor as an editable attribute of each player
-3D match, auto manage button no longer affects match speed
-Past Champions and Player of the Year have been fixed for all official competitions
-Editor fixes, including navigation, button visual feedback fixes and descriptions updated
-Improved the half pass animation to release the ball at the correct moment

notes.title: New Update 4th February
notes.notes:
Thanks to the epic support of our Discord Community, we have a load more fixes incoming!

The update includes the following:**
-Fixed incorrect setting of contract end date when signing a player
-Review of all player skin colour/beard settings has been amended. E.g. Gideon Gela Mosby was Caucasian
-Fixed problem with banned players sometimes still playing
-Fixed problem with some international clubs youth players not coming through as a majority from that nation
-Fixed overpowering 5th tackle kick/bomb for the attacking team
-Fixed putting injured players on subs bench
-Fixed game restarting with a frozen scrum
-Fixed problem with getting over 100 emails about 1st team clause
-Fixed problem with morale lowering to 0%, putting players on the transfer list instantly
-Incorrect reporting of training to position fixed and overlapping position text fixed
-Search filters on Players Contract screen resetting back to defaults when on that screen fixed
-Goal kicking sessions now shows correct number and isn’t stuck at 0 on the Training screen
-Team Selection now shows overall rating in the selection popup without having to look at each players individual profile
-Glitch when changing players secondary position to a different position fixed in Individual Training
-Positional Expertise column now scrolls in Staff Shortlist
-Duplicate Ruben Cotter fixed
-Misspelling of Rebuen Porter fixed and Chris Satae is now called Tevita Satae
-Clicking outside of the editor will now warn the player before exiting if they are currently editing a database
-Being able to put negative values in the contract terms is now fixed
-Warning message coming up everytime on Staff screen and Training Rota screens now fixed
-Jake Clifford’s primary position defaulting to secondary when training is fixed
-Overlapping shirt numbers on the backs of players that are subbed is now fixed
-Fixed duplicate name in HullKR. One of the Adam Rooks should have been Mikey Lewis

notes.title: New Update!
notes.notes:
The Update is now live and includes the following:
-Tutorial fixes, including navigation problems and skipping of certain sections by clicking the wrong things
-Fixed ProTips button showing up on screens with no help pop ups. Also fixed the tooltip for this button being there when the button is hidden. Fixed the protips issues on the staff overview screen. Fixed the visibility of satisfaction rating during negotiations.
-New contract length fixed
-Fixed individual training tooltips going off screen.
Now checks the region to determine whether snow should occur or not
-2D Match scaling fix.  Goal kick is now in line with the posts
-Added a weather option in the match settings to turn rain and snow off
-Updated 2nd Peter Hola to Reuben Cotter in the database and also fixed the editor to generate abbreviated names when a player name is changed
-White unreadable text on Assign Medic box fixed
-Popups appearing over the top of other windows fixed (e.g. Assign Medic as reported on Discord)
-Re-baked lighting and occlusion maps, match engine performance should be a little better
-Minor code optimization

notes.title: Update 9th January
notes.notes:
•	3 icons on Players screen, which were not working fully now fixed
•	Corrected an odd competition name on the Home screen
•	Fixed some odd 3D match bugs which had been game ending.

Again many thanks for all your support and feedback, in helping us  with the game

notes.title: Update 8th January
notes.notes:
•	Pause button in match fixed
•	Stop being able to double up doctor and physio assignments
•	Team selection squad numbers now work correctly
•	Surnames of coaches can now save correctly in the game's in built editor
•	Loan button now works in Transfers
•	"End of January" bug fixed
•	Correct some odd duplications of player names
•	Can now add players to squads in editor

We are continuing to work on and improve the game, and many thanks for all your positive feedback on our Discord server, we really appreciate it.
